name: Shailesh Jejurikar

career.title: Assistant Brand Manager, then brand and general management roles across India, East Africa, ASEAN, Korea, Singapore and North America
President, Global Fabric Care, later CEO of the Fabric & Home Care sector
President and CEO (Chairman of the Board from Aug. 1, 2026)

background_rationale: Joined P&G as an assistant brand manager in 1989 and rose through brand and category management, leading Fabric Care and Fabric & Home Care before becoming COO.

notable.summary: On his first earnings call as CEO, Jejurikar highlighted Pampers diapers made with silk fibers for China as part of a push toward premium products amid falling birth rates.
P&G's board named Jejurikar chairman effective Aug. 1, 2026, with executive chairman Jon Moeller leaving the board on July 31 and the company in mid-August.
Jejurikar said P&G would acquire the supplements brand Thorne.

personal_story.hook: A competitive cricketer from India, Shailesh Jejurikar joined P&G as an assistant brand manager in 1989 and now runs it.
personal_story.summary: Jejurikar was born in Mumbai and started school in an area outside the city he has described as "pretty much in the middle of nowhere." For eighth grade he moved to a boarding school in Hyderabad, where he discovered cricket, played competitively and was named head boy in his final year. When a chemistry teacher found his bed unmade and quietly made it for him, he took away a lesson he still cites. After an economics degree in Bombay and an MBA from IIM Lucknow, he joined P&G in 1989 as an assistant brand manager and spent more than three decades across Asia, Africa, Europe and North America, running Tide, Ariel and Downy before becoming COO and, in January 2026, CEO.
